a: Two view-backed loupes on one canvas share the lens view id, so the second's view replaces the first's and the first paints the second's picture
A host atlas passed as `font` is never used once the bundled one is registered; the attach logs "failed to register default font" instead, and the docs call a repeat call a no-op
A pointerdown focuses a widget that does not claim `pointer`, though the press itself falls through to the scene
The hover tracker keeps a widget removed from the HUD and later sends it `hoverleave` after it is disposed
b: Two view-backed loupes on one canvas share the view id `weasel-loupe:lens`, so the second replaces the first's view and the first draws the second's picture
`useLoupe` drops the pane region on the `source` path, so a pixel lens on a pane of a shared canvas reads the wrong pixels
A loupe window removed with `hud.remove` keeps its canvas view routing input until the next hover
`HudHost.registerLayer` is never called, so a custom host as `host.ts` describes it never receives the HUD's layer
A widget removed from the HUD stays in hover and open-press state and gets events after it is disposed
